summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K providing notice of its Ordinary and Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting scheduled for June 29, 2026, with a second call on June 30, 2026. Shareholders will vote on financial statements, board appointments with two alternative slates, treasury share authorization, a name change to Saentra Forge S.p.A., share capital delegation, and a reverse stock split to address Nasdaq non-compliance. The board may set the ratio post-approval. No financial terms, premiums, or advisors are disclosed. This is a routine governance filing typical of annual meetings and management proposals rather than a definitive special situation. Watch for shareholder voting outcomes and board composition changes.
